response.rationale: Both forms can express disgust, but Malaysian Malay geli is highly polysemous and commonly means ticklish or amused, so the missing false-friend contrast creates learner risk. The different-common-word relation is also too strong without usage evidence because Malay jijik is itself a direct disgust term and geli is not exclusive to Malaysian Malay.
